# `silk/platform/windows/start`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Synchronous Windows executable entry without a C runtime.

## When to use
The Windows hosted composition selects this module. It exports `mainCRTStartup`, captures
raw host inputs, invokes the application, and ends the process with `ExitProcess`.

## Details
`main` returns `i32`, `()`, or an effect of either result, optionally requiring `HostInput`.
Other requirements must be supplied by the application. Errors must implement `Debug`.
Unhandled errors use the shared bounded native report and exit with status 1.

## Gotchas
This entry does not support parking or install Windows exception handlers. Traps do not unwind.
